targets.title: ✦INTRADAY TRADER✦ Every red candle is an invoice for a lesson. Pay once, learn forever 🔥
targets.author: Intraday trader
targets.text:
Trading lessons for beginners: why every red candle and every loss in intraday trading is a lesson, and how to learn it once instead of paying for it again and again.
Every red candle is the market sending you an invoice for a lesson. Pay it once, learn it forever. Traders who review their losses and fix the mistake grow faster than traders who repeat the same error and blame the market. This video is for every intraday trader who wants to turn losses into experience.
How to learn from every red candle:
✦ Write down why you entered and why you exited
✦ Find the mistake: rule broken, late entry
